title: 10 Best Banisteria Caapi Preparations

Teas are a gentle way to consume the herb, often used for its calming and spiritual properties. Capsules offer a convenient and standardized form for regular intake, and creams can be applied topically for skin-related ailments. These preparations have been used for centuries in shamanic practices and are gaining recognition in contemporary herbal medicine.
